# Professional Description

Depositions, Inc. is a nationwide court reporting and litigation support firm with 25 years of experience providing comprehensive deposition services including court reporting, legal video, video conferencing, and transcription across North Carolina and beyond. Their high-resolution digital video technology and video/transcript synchronization capabilities enable attorneys to create compelling presentations and trial clips that capture critical non-verbal communication during depositions. With state-of-the-art facilities, technically trained realtime-ready court reporters, and nationwide conference room access, Depositions, Inc. delivers reliable, cost-effective solutions for litigation needs regardless of location or practice area.
